"The Saints are Coming" was the third single by the Scottish punk rock band Skids, featured on their 1979 debut album, Scared to Dance.
The song became an international hit when it was covered in 2006 by U2 and Green Day.
It was covered again in 2008 by Von Thronstahl.
The Irish rock band U2 has released 15 studio albums, two live albums, three compilation albums, 85 singles, and twelve extended plays (EPs).
The band formed at Mount Temple Comprehensive School in 1976 as teenagers.
In 1979, the group issued their first release, the EP U2-3, which sold well in Ireland.
